name: Quick fix — Grok implements, local gemma-4 reviews
description: Bespoke twin of quick-fix for multi-runtime independence: an ephemeral Grok 4.5 worker implements (runtime=grok, tools=ar-tools — required because grok has no Claude built-ins), a mechanical core:exec captures git status+diff as evidence, then local gemma-4 reviews via model:generate tier=local-review (cognitive-router → turboquant :8090). If rejected, the same Grok session resumes and fixes. ||| MISCONCEPTION THIS DEFINITION CORRECTS: gemma-4 is NOT an agent:run seat. agent:run only speaks claude|grok; workerProfile needs Anthropic-protocol upstreams. Local OpenAI-compat models enter as model:generate through a router tier (local-review → provider turboquant / model gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat). Gemma has NO filesystem tools — it judges the text it is handed, so the evidence node is load-bearing, not optional. ||| DELIBERATE DEPARTURES FROM stock quick-fix: (1) no ship node — this monorepo uses safe-commit with explicit paths, never git add -A; the caller ships. (2) no in-graph agent:notify — use POST body notify for a terminal status ping, or poll /workflow/runs. ||| BODY NOTIFY SHAPE (measured smoke wf-1786310716034-srtm6w): notify is an OBJECT {"agent":"...","message":"..."}, NOT a string — a string is silently ignored (run still starts). Custom message is NOT template-interpolated (fireNotify leaves {{run.correlationId}} literal); omit message to get the default which already embeds the real correlationId + status. Params: task (required), cwd (required — prepared worktree preferred). Fire: POST /workflow {"workflow":"quick-fix-grok-gemma","async":true,"fresh":true,"params":{"task":"...","cwd":"..."},"notify":{"agent":"grok-4.5-jonah"}}. ||| params.paths (optional, strongly recommended on dirty monorepos): comma-separated repo-relative paths that scope the evidence node. Without it, whole-tree dirt can starve gemma's answer budget.

params.prompt:
You are completing a quick, bounded task as the IMPLEMENTER in a multi-runtime workflow. A local model (gemma-4) will review your work from your summary plus a mechanical git status/diff — it cannot read the repo itself.

=== TASK ===
{{params.task}}

RULES:
- Be precise and minimal — do exactly what is asked, nothing more.
- Prefer surgical edits. Do NOT commit, push, or open a PR (the caller owns ship via safe-commit).
- Use ar-tools (read_file, edit_file, write_file, run_command, grep_search, …) for all file and shell work.

When done, reply with:
1. SUMMARY — one short paragraph of what changed and why.
2. FILES — bullet list of repo-relative paths you touched.
3. VERIFY — any commands you ran and their outcomes (tsc, tests, etc.).
4. RISKS — anything you could not verify or left incomplete.

meta.description: Implementer — ephemeral Grok 4.5 + ar-tools. Writes code; returns a reviewable summary.

params.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$raw = '{{params.paths}}'.Trim(); $scope = @(); if ($raw -and $raw -notmatch '^\{\{') { $scope = @($raw.Split(',') | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ }) }; Write-Output ('---SCOPE---'); if ($scope.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output '(whole tree — prefer params.paths for monorepo tasks)' } else { Write-Output ($scope -join ', ') }; Write-Output '---STATUS---'; if ($scope.Count -gt 0) { $st = (git status -s -- @scope | Out-String) } else { $st = (git status -s | Out-String) }; if ($st.Length -gt 6000) { Write-Output ($st.Substring(0,6000) + [Environment]::NewLine + '...[status truncated]') } else { Write-Output $st }; Write-Output '---DIFF-STAT---'; if ($scope.Count -gt 0) { git diff --stat -- @scope } else { git diff --stat }; Write-Output '---PATCH---'; if ($scope.Count -gt 0) { $p = (git diff -- @scope | Out-String) } else { $p = (git diff | Out-String) }; if ($p.Length -gt 20000) { Write-Output ($p.Substring(0,20000) + [Environment]::NewLine + '...[patch truncated at 20KB]') } else { Write-Output $p }; Write-Output '---STAGED---'; if ($scope.Count -gt 0) { git diff --cached --stat -- @scope } else { git diff --cached --stat }; Write-Output '---UNTRACKED---'; $all = @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- @scope); if ($scope.Count -eq 0) { $all = @(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) }; $u = @($all | Select-Object -First 12); if ($all.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output '(none)' } else { Write-Output ('count=' + $all.Count + ' showing=' + $u.Count); foreach ($f in $u) { Write-Output ('===FILE: ' + $f + '==='); try { $t = [IO.File]::ReadAllText((Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $f)); if ($t.Length -gt 4096) { Write-Output ($t.Substring(0,4096) + [Environment]::NewLine + '...[truncated at 4KB]') } else { Write-Output $t } } catch { Write-Output ('(unreadable: ' + $_.Exception.Message + ')') } }; if ($all.Count -gt 12) { Write-Output ('...[' + ($all.Count - 12) + ' more untracked omitted]') } }"

meta.description: Mechanical evidence (powershell, win32 core:exec). Optional params.paths (comma-separated) scopes status/diff/untracked — REQUIRED in practice for dirty monorepos. Caps: status 6KB, patch 20KB, untracked 12x4KB, maxOutputBytes 48KB. Scars: bash ; → git short; (smoke1); uncapped ~1MB → HTTP 400 (wf-…8cwtlr); whole-tree ~50KB + maxTokens 16k still exhausted reasoning (wf-…mwny11).
Reviewer — model:generate local-review (gemma-4). maxTokens 32768; short prompt. Pair with params.paths so evidence is task-scoped.

params.prompt:
A local gemma-4 reviewer checked your work (text-only: your summary + a mechanical git diff).

=== REVIEW ===
{{nodes.verify.result.reply}}

If the review starts with APPROVE, leave the tree as-is and reply exactly: No changes needed.
If it starts with REJECT (or otherwise lists problems), address every issue raised. Do NOT commit or push.

Reply with what you fixed (or 'No changes needed.').

meta.description: Fix — same Grok session as work. Resumes history; addresses gemma feedback if any.
